geometry_edits.rationale: Align the public threshold cut to the verified frontage/access edge so the entry seam reads directly on the access side.
Slightly deepen the access cut to make the ground response more legible without breaking the dominant hall mass.
Keep the notch proportioned as a clear entry/service articulation rather than a large void that would weaken the main hall.
Shift the roof/section language from barrel to folded to better express span and daylight while preserving a continuous hall gesture.
Maintain the long-span reading along the existing elongated axis.

rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent gymnasium mass across all four views: a low elongated hall datum with a single dominant roofed volume and a clear subordinate notch/indentation. The silhouette is resolved rather than arbitrary, and the section profile gives enough span/daylight implication to support a compact sports hall program. The blue frontage edge is answered by a legible ground-level cut/recess on that side, so the access relation is not sealed. It is somewhat box-led and the public void is modest, but not enough to fail the program. The form is also consistent between isometric, opposite, front, and top views, with no obvious view-to-view collisions.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Low horizontal pavilion with a clear roof plane and a recessed/public edge; useful for the court/entry relationship.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: More campus/building-bar than clear-span hall; limited roof/daylight logic.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Long low bar composition with subtle entry setback and attached side massing; good for hierarchy and frontage response.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Heavier public-plaza language than this candidate’s compact hall datum.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Terraced/stepped massing with a strong horizontal span and open concourse interface; transferable as a section and public-edge strategy.
Long low horizontal bar with deep canopy and transparent ground edge; reinforces entry/public threshold without over-fragmenting the mass.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: More boxy and less sectionally expressive than the candidate’s profiled hall intent.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Simple rectilinear mass with recessed ground level and roof terrace-like edge; useful as a restrained support/reference mass.

warnings: The public threshold is present but restrained; a deeper or more explicitly occupied void would better strengthen the access edge.
The roof/section is coherent for a compact training hall, but it stays near generic hall language rather than a more pronounced daylight structure.
